motion.name: html-gaveta
motion.purpose: Entrada e saída da gaveta inferior em telas estreitas.

shadows.name: html-fosforo
shadows.purpose: Brilho verde dos controles e indicadores CRT no HTML/JS.

shadows.name: react-legenda
shadows.purpose: Separa a legenda translúcida das ruas do mapa-base.

components.name: Aba ativa do mapa
components.description: Borda e brilho âmbar assinalam a aba selecionada no React.
components.css: .ds-react-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; width: 120px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid #ffcb00; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #ffcb00; font: 9px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255,203,0,0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,203,0,0.6), inset 0 0 10px rgba(255,203,0,0.12); } .ds-react-tab svg { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px #ffcb00); }

components.name: Chip de filtro ativo
components.description: Losango cheio e preenchimento âmbar sinalizam a seleção.
components.css: .ds-react-chip { padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #ffcb00; background: #ffcb0018; color: #ffcb00; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #ffcb0040; font: 12px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: all 150ms; }

components.name: Botão CRT
components.description: Ação primária nas telas nativas de sensores.
components.css: .ds-mobile-button { padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #00FF9F; background: transparent; color: #00FF9F; font: 13px monospace; letter-spacing: 1.5px; } .ds-mobile-button:active:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(0,255,159,0.12); } .ds-mobile-button:disabled { opacity: 0.35; }

components.name: Botão CRT para ação crítica
components.description: Borda e rótulo vermelhos no estado de ação crítica.
components.css: .ds-mobile-danger { padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #FF5454; background: transparent; color: #FF5454; font: 13px monospace; letter-spacing: 1.5px; } .ds-mobile-danger:active:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(0,255,159,0.12); } .ds-mobile-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.35; }

components.name: HUD de sensores
components.description: Título compacto e linhas de estado na moldura CRT nativa.
components.css: .ds-mobile-hud { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,159,0.35); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); color: #E6FFE6; font: 11px monospace; } .ds-mobile-hud-title { margin-bottom: 4px; color: #00FF9F; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
